name: settings-page-section
title: Settings section
description: One titled group of settings: a heading and description on one side, a stack of labelled controls on the other, with an optional save row.

frame.summary: CLAUDE.md lists settings groups under Card. Intro beside the group when wide; stacked when narrow.

regions.name: intro
regions.purpose: Group heading and what these settings affect.

regions.name: group
regions.purpose: The controls, one row each, divided.

regions.name: actions
regions.purpose: Save / cancel when the group saves explicitly.

components.name: segmented-control
components.for: Two to four mutually exclusive modes (theme: light/dark/system).

components.name: list
components.for: Row structure: label + description at start, control at end.

dependsOnFuture.interim: border-block-end with theme.border.default on each row.
Rows laid out by the block's own grid using Field.
Inline status text next to the control ("Saved").

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the group heading (2 under the settings page's h1); everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

saveMode.summary: Whether changes apply immediately or on Save.
use: `explicit` for groups with text fields, where a half-typed value must not apply.
dont: Mixing both in one group. Split the group instead.

behavior.summary: Explicit mode tracks dirty state and enables Save only then (aria-disabled otherwise); immediate mode saves per control.

decisions.why: Switches that need a Save, or text fields that save mid-word, are both common failures; making the caller choose prevents the default being wrong for half the groups.

decisions.decision: The group is a <fieldset> with a <legend> when it holds related radios/checkboxes, otherwise a labelled section
decisions.why: fieldset/legend is how a control set gets its group name read; a section of unrelated settings is not a fieldset.

decisions.decision: Leaving with unsaved changes is the template's concern
decisions.why: Only the page knows about routing; the block exposes `dirty` for it.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the block's own heading (the group heading)

obligations: Every control has a visible label; Switch's description explains the effect.
A destructive setting (delete account) is a separate danger group with a confirming Dialog, not a row here.

steps.change: Intro above the card; rows stack label over control.
Intro beside the card; rows put the control at the inline end.

native.reason: App block: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: A grouped list section: section header = title, footer = description, rows = controls (switch rows, disclosure rows that push a picker for Select).
native.ios: Form / List with .insetGrouped style; Section header/footer.

tokenGaps.need: Narrow / medium / wide breakpoint tokens — adopted by decision B2, names and values pending the design-tokens interview
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts, until the B2 tokens land.
